question: Avec deux amis, nous avons fondé une société en commandite dans laquelle je ne réponds des dettes que jusqu'à un montant fixé. Avant même que la société soit inscrite au registre du commerce, elle a passé des commandes chez un fournisseur, qui me réclame maintenant à moi seul la totalité de la facture. Est-ce que je dois vraiment payer plus que ma part limitée ?

gold_facts.text: If the limited partnership did business before being entered in the commercial register, the limited partner is liable to third parties like a partner with unlimited liability for the partnership's obligations that arose before registration.
This unlimited liability does not apply if the limited partner proves that the third parties knew his liability was limited.

competing_candidates: The general limited-partnership rule that the limited partner is liable only up to the registered limited sum (it states the normal limit, not the pre-registration exception).

question: Ho autorizzato mio fratello a comprare per me un'auto usata da un privato. Lui l'ha acquistata, ma al venditore non ha mai detto che lo faceva per conto mio. Adesso chi è legato al venditore, io o mio fratello? Posso pretendere io direttamente la consegna dell'auto?

gold_facts.text: Rights and obligations from a contract concluded by an authorised representative in another person's name pass to the person represented.

If the representative did not disclose that he was acting as a representative, the represented person becomes directly creditor or debtor only if the other party had to infer the agency from the circumstances or did not care with whom it contracted.
In other cases, an assignment of the claim or an assumption of the debt is needed.

competing_candidates: The neighbouring articles on the scope of authority and on ratification of acts done without authority (the question states that authority was given).

question: In my canton, cleaning firms keep paying new staff far below what is normal in the region, and there is no sector-wide collective agreement with minimum wages that could be made binding for everyone. Who can get a compulsory minimum wage imposed for this sector, how is the problem normally handled before that happens, and would such a minimum wage apply forever?

gold_facts.text: Where wages below those customary for the place, occupation or sector are repeatedly and abusively offered and no collective agreement with minimum wage provisions can be declared generally binding, the competent authority may, at the request of the tripartite commission, issue a fixed-term standard employment contract with minimum wages differentiated by region.

The validity of such a standard employment contract can be extended for a fixed period, on the commission's proposal, if its minimum wage rules are repeatedly breached or new abuses are expected after it expires.
The Confederation and each canton set up a tripartite commission made up of equal numbers of employer and employee representatives plus representatives of the state.

When the commission finds such abuses it normally first seeks a direct agreement with the employers concerned, and if none is reached within two months it proposes a standard employment contract with minimum wages to the competent authority.

competing_candidates: The general article on the standard employment contract and how it is issued (it does not set the minimum wage conditions or the commission's role).

question: Ich habe zusammen mit vielen anderen Anlegern gleichartige Obligationen eines Unternehmens bei derselben Bank hinterlegt. Jetzt will das Unternehmen alle unsere einzelnen Papiere durch eine einzige Sammelurkunde ersetzen. Darf es das ohne Weiteres, und was ist diese eine Urkunde dann rechtlich, wem gehört sie?

gold_facts.text: The debtor may issue a global certificate or replace several fungible securities entrusted to a single custodian with one, provided the terms of issue or the articles of association allow it or the depositors have consented.
The global certificate is a security of the same type as the individual rights it represents.
It is co-owned by the participating depositors in proportion to their holdings.

competing_candidates: The neighbouring article on collective custody of fungible securities, which also gives depositors co-ownership of the pooled stock (it does not deal with replacing papers by one certificate).

question: Four of us run an informal joint venture together (a simple partnership, not a registered company) with no end date agreed. One of the partners has just died, and we never agreed anything about what happens with his heirs. Does the partnership come to an end because of his death? And apart from that, could one of us end it at once for a serious reason without first giving notice?

gold_facts.text: A simple partnership is dissolved when a partner dies, unless it was agreed beforehand that it would continue with the heirs.
A partner may terminate the partnership by notice if this is reserved in the contract or if the partnership was entered into for an indefinite period or for a partner's lifetime.
For important reasons, dissolution may be demanded without prior notice where the partnership was concluded for an indefinite period.

competing_candidates: The following simple-partnership article on the notice period for termination (the question does not ask for the period).
The general-partnership dissolution rules, which refer to the simple-partnership rules.

question: J'ai perdu une obligation au porteur et j'ai demandé au tribunal de la déclarer sans valeur. Le délai que le juge avait fixé pour que la personne qui la détient se manifeste est maintenant passé, et personne ne l'a présentée. Que va-t-il se passer, et qu'est-ce que je peux obtenir ensuite ?

gold_facts.text: If the security is not produced within the set period, the court may cancel it or take other appropriate measures.
The cancellation of a bearer security is published immediately in the Swiss Official Gazette of Commerce and by any other means the court considers useful.
Once cancellation is pronounced, the applicant may ask for a new security at his own expense or for payment of the debt if it is due.

competing_candidates: The cancellation procedures for registered securities and for bills of exchange and cheques, which have their own rules on the effect of cancellation (the question concerns a bearer bond).

question: Ho affidato i miei quadri a un mercante d'arte perché li venda a nome suo ma per conto mio. Non gli avevo dato istruzioni sul pagamento. Lui ne ha venduto uno a un cliente lasciandogli pagare più tardi, e ora il cliente non paga. Chi sopporta la perdita, io o il mercante?

gold_facts.text: A commission agent who makes advances or grants credit to a third party without the principal's consent does so at his own risk.
Unless the principal has instructed otherwise, the commission agent may sell on credit if that is the commercial custom at the place of sale.

competing_candidates: The commission-contract article on the agent who guarantees the buyer's payment (del credere), which applies only if the agent took on that guarantee.

question: Ich habe vor 18 Monaten bei einem Elektronikgeschäft einen neuen Fernseher für unser Wohnzimmer gekauft. Jetzt zeigt sich ein Defekt, der offenbar schon von Anfang an da war. In den Geschäftsbedingungen steht, dass Ansprüche wegen Mängeln nach einem Jahr ab Kauf erlöschen. Ist es für mich wirklich schon zu spät?

gold_facts.text: Claims for defects in the goods become time-barred two years after delivery to the buyer, even if the buyer discovers the defects later, unless the seller accepted liability for longer.

An agreement shortening the limitation period is invalid if it reduces it below two years (one year for used goods), the item is for the buyer's personal or family use, and the seller acts in a professional or commercial capacity.

competing_candidates: The sales-law article on contractual exclusion or limitation of the seller's warranty (it concerns excluding liability, not shortening the time limit).
The limitation rule for defects in a contract for work, which applies to commissioned work rather than a purchase.

question: I sit on the executive management of a Swiss company whose shares are traded on the stock exchange, and I am about to leave. My contract promises me a lump-sum payment of one year's salary when I go. Can the company legally pay me that? And can it at least keep paying my normal salary until my contract actually ends?

gold_facts.text: In companies with listed shares, severance payments agreed by contract or provided for in the articles of association may not be paid to current or former members of the board of directors, the executive board or the advisory board, or to persons close to them.
Payments owed until the end of the contract are not considered severance payments.

question: Mein Arbeitgeber ist an einen Gesamtarbeitsvertrag gebunden, ich selbst bin aber in keiner Gewerkschaft. Kann ich mich diesem Vertrag trotzdem persönlich unterstellen, was muss dafür formell erfüllt sein, und wie könnte ich mich später wieder davon lösen, wenn der Vertrag ohne festes Enddatum abgeschlossen wurde?

gold_facts.text: Workers employed by an employer bound by the collective agreement may individually submit to it with the consent of the contracting parties, and are then considered bound by it.
The individual declaration of submission and the consent of the parties must be in writing.

A collective agreement not concluded for a fixed term can, unless otherwise agreed, be terminated by any party after one year with six months' notice, and this applies by analogy to an individual submission.

question: En déchargeant un camion dans ma rue, un ouvrier d'une entreprise de construction a laissé tomber une planche sur ma voiture garée. Je n'ai aucun contrat avec cette entreprise. Puis-je demander à l'entreprise elle-même de payer la réparation plutôt qu'à l'ouvrier, et comment pourrait-elle y échapper ?

gold_facts.text: An employer is liable for damage caused by its employees or other auxiliaries in the performance of their work.
The employer escapes liability if it proves it took all the care required by the circumstances to prevent such damage, or that the damage would have occurred even with that care.
The employer may seek recourse against the person who caused the damage to the extent that person is himself liable.

competing_candidates: The general tort liability rule for one's own fault, and the contractual rule on liability for auxiliaries (the question states there is no contract).

question: Ich bin Mitglied einer Genossenschaft. An der Generalversammlung schlägt die Verwaltung vor, vom Jahresgewinn mehr zurückzulegen, als Gesetz und Statuten vorschreiben, und zusätzlich einen Betrag für die Altersvorsorge der Angestellten abzuzweigen, obwohl die Statuten dazu nichts sagen. Darf die Versammlung das beschliessen, bevor der Rest an die Mitglieder verteilt wird?

gold_facts.text: From the annual profit available for distribution, the allocations to reserve and other funds required by law and the articles must be made first.
The general meeting may also set aside reserves not provided for, or exceeding what is required, by law and the articles if this seems appropriate to ensure the lasting prosperity of the business.

The general meeting may, even without a basis in the articles, deduct amounts from the annual profit to create and support welfare institutions for employees, workers or members, and these are subject to the rules on statutory welfare funds.

competing_candidates: The preceding cooperative article on the legal reserve and on welfare funds set up in the articles.
The analogous stock-company rules on reserves (the brief places this article in the cooperative title).

question: Ho comprato dei titoli digitali emessi da una società svizzera e iscritti in un registro su blockchain. Le spiegazioni che mi hanno dato su come funziona il registro e su come è protetto erano fuorvianti, e ci ho perso dei soldi. La società deve risarcirmi? E vale la clausola delle sue condizioni che esclude qualsiasi responsabilità?

gold_facts.text: The obligor under a ledger-based security must inform every acquirer of the content of the right and of how the register works and is protected.
The obligor is liable for damage caused to the acquirer by incorrect, misleading or legally non-compliant information, unless it proves it exercised the required care.
Agreements that limit or exclude this liability are void.

competing_candidates: The neighbouring article on the requirements for the ledger register itself (it sets requirements, not information duties or liability).

question: In our cooperative, the articles say that members are personally liable for the cooperative's debts. Who has to check that the list of members is kept properly? And who does it if the cooperative has chosen not to have an auditor at all?

gold_facts.text: Where members are personally liable or obliged to make additional payments, the auditor checks whether the register of members is kept correctly.
If the cooperative has no auditor, the board of directors must have the register of members checked by a licensed auditor.

competing_candidates: The cooperative article on the duty to keep a register of members (it imposes the register, not its verification).

question: Mon patron a une assurance qui le couvre si on lui réclame des dommages-intérêts, et il retient sur mon salaire au moins la moitié des primes de cette assurance. Qui peut faire valoir les droits découlant de ce contrat d'assurance : lui ou moi ?

gold_facts.text: Where the employer is insured against civil liability and the worker has paid at least half of the premiums, the rights under the insurance belong exclusively to the worker.

competing_candidates: Insurance Contract Act rules on liability insurance and the injured party's rights (they do not deal with premiums paid by the worker).

question: Ich hatte mit einer Kollektivgesellschaft von zwei Brüdern zu tun. Der Bruder, der die Geschäfte führt, hat mit mir einen Liefervertrag abgeschlossen, ohne ausdrücklich zu sagen, dass er für die Firma handelt. Bei einem anderen Firmenauftrag hat er meinen Zaun mutwillig beschädigt. Muss die Gesellschaft selbst den Vertrag erfüllen und für den Schaden am Zaun aufkommen?

gold_facts.text: The general partnership acquires rights and is bound by the acts of a managing partner done in its name.
It is sufficient that the intention to act for the partnership follows from the circumstances.
The partnership is liable for damage resulting from unlawful acts committed by a partner in the conduct of the partnership's business.

competing_candidates: The following general-partnership article on the partners' personal liability for the partnership's debts.
The limited-partnership rules, which refer to the general-partnership rules on representation.

question: Notre société anonyme a racheté une partie de ses propres actions. Est-ce que ces actions donnent encore le droit de voter à l'assemblée générale ? Et comment et à quel endroit précis doivent-elles apparaître dans le bilan ?

gold_facts.text: When a company acquires its own shares, the voting rights and associated rights attached to them are suspended.
The company must show in the balance sheet an amount equal to their acquisition cost as a deduction from equity.

Under equity, the minimum balance sheet structure lists, in order, share capital, the statutory capital reserve, the statutory retained earnings, voluntary retained earnings, own shares as a negative item, profit or loss carried forward and the annual profit or loss.

competing_candidates: The stock-company article setting the limits on acquiring own shares (it does not cover voting or balance sheet presentation).

question: Ho venduto la mia moto a un conoscente e dovevo consegnargliela questa settimana, ma nel frattempo lui è morto e nessuno sa chi siano i suoi eredi. Io non ho nessuna colpa in questo. Che cosa posso fare, visto che non ho nessuno a cui consegnarla?

gold_facts.text: The debtor may deposit the performance or withdraw from the contract, as in the case of the creditor's default, if the performance cannot be offered to the creditor or his representative for another reason relating to the creditor's person.
The same applies if there is uncertainty about who the creditor is and the debtor is not at fault for it.

competing_candidates: The articles on the creditor's default that set out how deposit and withdrawal work (they apply here by reference but do not cover the unknown-creditor case).

question: I work as a travelling sales rep on a fixed salary plus commission. I broke my leg and cannot visit customers for two months, through no fault of my own, and my employer has to keep paying me during that time. Is my pay just the fixed salary, or do I also get something for the commission I am missing? And can my boss make me work in the office instead while I'm off the road?

gold_facts.text: If a commercial traveller is prevented from travelling through no fault of his own and is still entitled to pay, the pay consists of the fixed salary plus fair compensation for the lost commission.
If commission is less than one fifth of the pay, it may be agreed in writing that no compensation for lost commission is due during such a period.
If the traveller still receives full pay, he must on the employer's request work in the employer's business, provided he is able to and it can reasonably be expected of him.

competing_candidates: The general employment-contract rule on continued pay when the worker is prevented from working by illness or accident (the question assumes pay is owed).

question: J'ai 19 ans et je quitte mon emploi après seulement huit mois chez cet employeur. Combien de congés payés devais-je recevoir au minimum, et est-ce que j'ai droit à une année complète de congés alors que je ne suis pas resté un an ?

gold_facts.text: The employer must grant at least four weeks of holiday per year of service, and at least five weeks to workers up to the age of 20.
If the year of service is incomplete, the holiday is set in proportion to the length of the employment.

competing_candidates: The neighbouring employment-contract articles on when holidays are taken and on holiday pay (they do not set the length).

question: Ich bin Aktionär einer börsenkotierten AG, die der ordentlichen Revision unterliegt. Schaut die Revisionsstelle nach, ob es überhaupt ein internes Kontrollsystem gibt und ob der Bericht über die Vergütungen korrekt ist? Und beurteilt sie auch, ob der Verwaltungsrat das Unternehmen gut geführt hat?

gold_facts.text: The auditor checks whether the annual accounts comply with the law, the articles and the chosen accounting framework, and whether the board's proposal on the use of the balance sheet profit complies with the law and the articles.
The auditor checks whether an internal control system exists and, for listed companies, whether the compensation report complies with the law and the articles.
The board of directors' management of the company is not subject to the auditor's review.

competing_candidates: The stock-company article on the scope of a limited audit, which also excludes the board's management from review (the question states an ordinary audit and asks about the internal control system and compensation report, which only A covers).

question: Ho un negozio di articoli sportivi e ho ordinato a un grossista una partita di costumi da bagno con consegna fissata per il primo maggio. Il fornitore è in ritardo. Che cosa si presume che io voglia a questo punto, e se invece voglio comunque ricevere la merce, che cosa devo fare?

gold_facts.text: In commercial dealings, where a specific delivery date was agreed and the seller is in default, the buyer is presumed to waive delivery and to claim damages for non-performance.
If the buyer prefers to demand delivery, he must notify the seller immediately after the delivery date has passed.

competing_candidates: The general rules on the creditor's options when the debtor is in default under a bilateral contract (A sets a special presumption for commercial sales with a fixed date).

question: Lavoro in una grande società anonima quotata in borsa: nel consiglio di amministrazione le donne sono solo il 10 per cento. La società è obbligata a giustificare pubblicamente questa situazione e a dire cosa intende fare? E a partire da quali dimensioni dell'azienda vale questo obbligo?

gold_facts.text: If one sex is not represented by at least 30 percent on the board of directors and at least 20 percent on the executive board of a company exceeding the relevant thresholds, the compensation report must state the reasons.
The compensation report must also state the measures taken to promote the under-represented sex.

The thresholds are met when a company exceeds, in two consecutive financial years, two of the following: a balance sheet total of CHF 20 million, a turnover of CHF 40 million, and 250 full-time positions on annual average.

question: I bought tickets in Switzerland for a prize draw that is licensed in another country, and I won. The organiser now refuses to pay out. Can I go to a Swiss court to force them to pay my winnings?

gold_facts.text: Lotteries and prize draws give rise to an enforceable claim only if they were authorised by the competent authority, otherwise the rules on gambling debts apply.
Lotteries authorised abroad do not enjoy legal protection in Switzerland unless the competent authority has permitted the sale of the tickets.

competing_candidates: The article on gambling and betting debts, which says they cannot be enforced (A applies it to unauthorised lotteries).

question: Un restaurateur devait me rendre mon tableau le 1er mars. Il a traîné sans aucune excuse, et le 10 mars un incendie dont il n'est pas responsable a détruit son atelier avec mon tableau. Il dit qu'il n'y est pour rien. Doit-il quand même m'indemniser, et dans quels cas pourrait-il s'en sortir ?

gold_facts.text: A debtor in default must compensate the damage caused by late performance and is also liable for accidental loss.

He escapes this liability if he proves that the default occurred through no fault of his own, or that the accident would also have struck the object to the creditor's detriment had he performed on time.

competing_candidates: The contract-for-work rule on who bears the risk when the work or the client's material perishes before delivery (it does not address a contractor already in default).

question: In meinem Arbeitsvertrag steht nichts dazu, wann der Lohn ausbezahlt wird, und für meine Branche gibt es keinen Gesamtarbeitsvertrag. Wann muss mein Arbeitgeber mir den Lohn zahlen? Und ich bin am Jahresgewinn beteiligt: bis wann muss dieser Anteil spätestens ausbezahlt sein?

gold_facts.text: Unless a shorter period or other pay period is agreed, customary or set by a standard or collective employment contract, the salary is paid at the end of each month.
A share in the business result is paid as soon as the result is established, but no later than six months after the end of the financial year.

competing_candidates: The employment-contract article on how a profit share is calculated and the worker's right to information (it does not set the due date).
